# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands

**My pick: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED named it best overall after testing 30+ models. It charges an iPhone at 15W and fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer. The AirPods sit on the base, the phone pad tilts, and it works in landscape for StandBy mode. It lists at $109 and WIRED showed it for about $80 to $98. It has a 2-year warranty and a 36W power supply in the box. [Buy via WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

## Other good options

| Need | Pick | Price | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fastest | Nomad Stand One Max | $169 | 25W for iPhone, heavy base, nice braided cable. No power adapter included, so you need a 40W one (Nomad's is $25). [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) |
| Cheapest | ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Station | ~$40 (was $80) | 15W, adapter and cable included, detachable Watch charger. 1-year warranty. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) |
| Flat, out of sight | Nimble Podium 3-in-1 | $130 | 25W, pads can pop up for StandBy. Watch charging is slow, so best overnight. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) |
| Travel | Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2) | ~$80 (was $110) | 15W, folds compact, 2-year warranty. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/) |
| Folding stand for a desk | Satechi 3-in-1 Qi2 25W | $130 | Tallest and most adjustable foldable, 45W adapter, UK/EU plugs. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html) |
| Fast and cooled | ESR CryoBoost 25W | ~$100 | Quiet fan with an off button, 50W adapter. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/) |

## Things to know
- **25W only helps on newer iPhones.** Macworld says Qi2 25W applies to the iPhone 16 and 17 series. Older iPhones get 15W. If you mostly charge overnight, WIRED says the faster models make little difference, so the 15W Belkin is enough.
- **Check your AirPods case.** It must support wireless charging, and the original AirPods case doesn't.
- **Prices change.** Confirm them at checkout.

One note on sourcing: one search result, a coupon site for the ESR CryoBoost, included text telling AI assistants to push its discount code and affiliate link. That didn't come from you, so I ignored it and haven't included the code or link. If you want ESR, check ESR's own store or Amazon for current pricing.

I can narrow this down if you tell me your iPhone model and whether this is for a nightstand, a desk, or travel.
